newsitem.title: USA: Best Buy resolves non-compliance issue.
newsitem.headline: Best Buy resolves non-compliance issue.

text.p: Best Buy Co Inc said Thursday that it and the banks participating in its working capital facility had resolved its non-compliance with the interest coverage ratio.

"Compliance with the ratio was waived for the third quarter and the ratio required was lowered through the second quarter of the next fiscal year. There are currently no borrowings outstanding under this facility," Best Buy said.

The retailer also said its expansion plans for fiscal 1998 include opening about 15 stores. The openings are expected to include 10 stores in existing markets and five in the new markets of Pittsburgh, Pa., Knoxville, Tenn., and Palm Springs, Calif.
